description:
Nine real brain parasites, from a fluke that makes a fish dance for a heron to a soil amoeba that kills about nine in ten of the people it reaches, and Doug hosts every one. First as a killifish, an ant and a sheep, then as himself.

Which parasite should Doug never meet next? Tell us in the comments.
